tasks.label: deps: up
tasks.detail: Start Postgres, OpenTelemetry Collector, Prometheus, Grafana (:3000) and the Aspire dashboard (:18888) in Docker
tasks.command: docker compose up -d --wait db otel-collector prometheus grafana dashboard

tasks.label: deps: down
tasks.detail: Stop the local dependencies (database and metrics data are kept)

tasks.label: db: reset
tasks.detail: Delete the database and metrics volumes, then recreate the database from database/schema.sql
tasks.command: docker compose down -v; docker compose up -d --wait db otel-collector prometheus grafana dashboard

tasks.label: compose: up (full stack)
tasks.detail: Run the whole stack in Docker on http://localhost:8080
